name: autorecord
desc: If enabled, replay demos are automatically recorded in Record Attack /NiGHTS Mode.

name: compactscoreboard
desc: If enabled, the multiplayer intermission screen is always displayed in its compact form, which is otherwise only used if there are 20 or more players in the game.

name: ghost_bestrings
desc: Determines whether ghosts for the "Best Rings" records are displayed during Record Attack runs – " Show " shows only the ghost for the currently selected skin, while " Show All " shows ghosts for all skins.

name: ghost_bestscore
desc: Determines whether ghosts for the "Best Score" records are displayed during Record Attack runs – " Show " shows only the ghost for the currently selected skin, while " Show All " shows ghosts for all skins.

name: ghost_besttime
desc: Determines whether ghosts for the "Best Time" records are displayed during Record Attack runs – " Show " shows only the ghost for the currently selected skin, while " Show All " shows ghosts for all skins.

name: ghost_guest
desc: Determines whether ghosts for guest replays are displayed during Record Attack runs.

name: ghost_last
desc: Determines whether ghosts for the last recorded replay(s) are displayed during Record Attack runs – " Show " shows only the ghost for the currently selected skin, while " Show All " shows ghosts for all skins.

name: hazardlog
desc: If enabled, a message is shown in the console if a player is harmed by a hazard in Match and derived gametypes.

name: itemfinder
desc: Enables/disables the emblem radar, if it has already been unlocked.

name: playbackspeed
desc: Sets the speed at which a demo is played back. Minimum value is 1, maximum value is 10.

name: rollingdemos
desc: If enabled, title screen demos are played after a certain amount of time has passed on the title screen.

name: runscripts
desc: Determines whether console scripts initiated by linedef type 415 or a level's ScriptName parameter are executed.

name: seenames
desc: Controls how the names of other players are displayed when targeting them.

name: showhud
desc: Determines whether the Game HUD is displayed. Does not affect the Rankings/Scores HUD .

name: timerres
desc: Determines the type of timer displayed on the HUD in-game.

name: translucenthud
desc: Sets the translucency of the Game HUD . The values range from 0 (invisible) to 10 (opaque). Does not affect the Rankings/Scores HUD .

name: addons_folder
desc: If addons_option is set to Custom , this defines the folder the Addons menu searches in. You can use relative paths (e.g.: addons ) to define a folder relative to the SRB2 directory, or a full-length directory path (e.g.: C:/Users/ExampleUser/SRB2Addons ) to search for addons in a different folder than the SRB2 directory.

name: addons_md5
desc: Determines how the game checks if two addon files are identical. This is used to determine which files are marked as "loaded" in the Addons menu – any file that is considered identical to an already loaded file is marked as "loaded".

name: addons_option
desc: Determines the folder that the Addons menu searches in.

name: addons_search_case
desc: Determines whether the filename search in the Addons menu is case-sensitive or not.

name: addons_search_type
desc: Determines how the filename search in Addons menu works.

name: addons_showall
desc: If disabled, the Addons menu will only show files with a supported type ( .txt , .cfg , .wad , .pk3 , .soc and .lua ). If enabled, even unsupported files will be shown.

name: con_backcolor
desc: Sets the background color of the console and the chat window. Both the colors' names or their number values can be used here.

name: con_backpic
desc: Determines whether the console uses a background picture or not when opened.

name: con_height
desc: Sets the height of the console. The value used is a percentage of the screen's height.

name: con_hudlines
desc: Sets the number of lines the console may display on the HUD when not opened. Minimum value is 1, maximum value is 20. Note: the actual number of lines displayed is one less than the value of this variable; e.g. con_hudlines 8 will make the console display up to 7 lines.

name: con_hudtime
desc: Sets how long the console's HUD messages last on the screen, in seconds. A value of 0 disables the messages.

name: con_speed
desc: Sets the rate at which the console moves when being opened or closed. The maximum value is 255. A value of 0 disables the animation and opens/closes the console instantly.

name: con_textsize
desc: Sets the scale of text in the console. Note that despite the names of the accepted strings, the actual displayed text sizes depend on the screen resolution. See Video flags > Scale for more information on the effects of the corresponding video flags given for each of the options below.

name: chatbacktint
desc: If enabled, received chat messages are displayed on the tinted translucent background that is also used for the console and the full chat window. If disabled, they are laid over the screen directly.

name: chatheight
desc: Sets the height of the chat window, as the number of lines that are visible at the same. Minimum value is 6, maximum value is 22.

name: chatmode
desc: Sets the chat mode.

name: chatnotifications
desc: Determines whether a sound effect is played when a chat message is sent or received.

name: chatspamprotection
desc: Enables/disables spam protection. If spam protection is enabled and a player sends too many messages in rapid succession, they will be hidden from the chat window.

name: chattime
desc: Sets the time in seconds that a received chat message stays on-screen before it disappears. Minimum value is 5, maximum value is 999.

name: chatwidth
desc: Sets the width of the chat window. The value given is the number of pixels that the chat window would occupy in the base resolution, which has a width of 320. In higher resolutions, the window is scaled accordingly. Minimum value is 64, maximum value is 150.

name: apng_compress_level
desc: Sets the compression level for animated PNGs, ranging from 0 to 9. 0 completely disables compression (not recommended), 1 is best speed, and 9 is best compression.

name: apng_memory_level
desc: Sets the memory level for animated PNGs, ranging from 1 to 9. This affects how much memory will be used during compression; lowering it will result in less memory usage, but at the cost of slower/worse compression.

name: apng_speed
desc: Sets the playback speed of animated PNGs.

name: apng_strategy
desc: Determines which type of compression should be used for animated PNGs.

name: apng_window_size
desc: Specifies the size of the compression window for animated PNGs. Smaller values mean less memory usage, but at the expense of worse compression.

name: gif_downscale
desc: Determines whether GIF movies are downscaled or not. If enabled, GIFs are recorded with an image size of 320×200 (or a similar ratio) rather than the screen's resolution. If disabled, the image size will be the same as the screen's resolution. Note: Changing this variable while a GIF is currently being recorded will not change the GIF's image size.

name: gif_optimize
desc: Determines whether GIF movies are optimized or not. Note: Changing this variable while a GIF is currently being recorded will not change how the GIF will be written.

name: moviemode_mode
desc: Determines the format in which the movies recorded with the startmovie command are saved. " GIF " is exclusive to the Software rendering mode; in OpenGL " aPNG " is automatically used even when " GIF " is set.

name: png_compress_level
desc: Sets the compression level for screenshots , ranging from 0 to 9. 0 completely disables compression (not recommended), 1 is best speed, and 9 is best compression.

name: png_memory_level
desc: Sets the memory level for screenshots, ranging from 0 to 9. This affects how much memory will be used during compression; lowering it will result in less memory usage, but at the cost of slower/worse compression.

name: png_strategy
desc: Determines which type of compression should be used for screenshots.

name: png_window_size
desc: Specifies the size of the compression window for screenshots. Smaller values mean less memory usage, but at the expense of worse compression.

name: screenshot_folder
desc: If screenshot_option is set to Custom , this defines the folder in which screenshots and movies are saved. You can use relative paths (e.g.: screenshots ) to define a folder relative to the SRB2 directory, or a full-length directory path (e.g.: C:/Users/ExampleUser/SRB2Screenshots ) to save them in a different folder than the SRB2 directory.

name: screenshot_option
desc: Determines where screenshots and movies of SRB2 are saved.

name: op_flags
desc: Sets the flags value for Things that are placed in Object placement mode . Ranges from 0 to 15.

name: op_mapthingnum
desc: Sets the Thing type number of Things spawned in Object placement mode . If set to 0, the user can cycle through the Thing types to place with the "Rotate Camera" controls. Setting op_mapthingnum to a specific Thing type overrides this and causes Things of the specified type to be placed instead. Thing types without a corresponding Object type cannot be spawned, and an error will be shown in the console when attempting to. Ranges from 0 to 4095.

name: op_speed
desc: Sets the player's speed when moving in any direction in Object placement mode . Ranges from 1 to 128.

name: alwaysmlook
desc: If enabled, mouse aiming in first-person view is generally enabled and can be disabled by pressing the mouselook key. If disabled, mouse aiming in first-person view is generally disabled and can be enabled by pressing the mouselook key.

name: analog
desc: Turns analog control on or off. To enable/disable analog control permanently, useranalog/useranalog2 should be used instead, as this variable is modified by the game on certain occasions.

name: chasecam
desc: Turns the third-person camera on or off. If off, the first-person view is used.

name: chasemlook
desc: If enabled, mouse aiming in third-person view is generally enabled and can be disabled by pressing the mouselook key. If disabled, mouse aiming in third-person view is generally disabled and can be enabled by pressing the mouselook key.

name: controlperkey
desc: Sets how many controls may be assigned to a key. 1 is one, 2 is several.

name: crosshair
desc: Sets the type of crosshair used in first-person view:

name: invertmouse
desc: If enabled, looking up and down with the mouse is inverted.

name: joyscale
desc: Sets the scale of the input from joystick axes. If set to 0, they will behave like a gamepad controller. [ confirm? – discuss ]

name: mouse2port
desc: Determines the computer port of the mouse for player 2, if one is used. Values range from COM1 to COM4 , or 1 to 4. You may need to try out different values to find the port your mouse uses.

name: mousemove
desc: If enabled, moving the mouse will move the character when mouse aiming is disabled.

name: mousesens
desc: Sets the sensitivity of mouse movement for turning left and right. Minimum value is 1, maximum value is 100.

name: mouseysens
desc: Sets the sensitivity of mouse movement for turning up and down. Minimum value is 1, maximum value is 100.

name: use_gamepad
desc: Determines the joystick device number used for the player's joystick controls . If set to 0, no joystick is used.

name: use_mouse
desc: Determines whether the mouse can be used for controls or not. The value Force has the same effect as On .

name: useranalog
desc: If enabled, analog control is set as the default control scheme. This variable should be used instead of analog/analog2 .

name: joyaxis_fire
desc: Sets the joystick axis to use for triggering the Fire button.

name: joyaxis_firenormal
desc: Sets the joystick axis to use for triggering the Fire Normal button.

name: joyaxis_jump
desc: Sets the joystick axis to use for triggering the Jump button.

name: joyaxis_look
desc: Sets the joystick axis to use for looking up/down.

name: joyaxis_move
desc: Sets the joystick axis to use for forward/backward movement.

name: joyaxis_side
desc: Sets the joystick axis to use for sideways movement.

name: joyaxis_spin
desc: Sets the joystick axis to use for triggering the Spin button.

name: joyaxis_turn
desc: Sets the joystick axis to use for turning left/right.

name: cam_dist
desc: Sets the distance of the camera. You cannot use a negative value to zoom in. This distance is multiplied by 1.5 in two-player mode and by 1.2 if playing with analog control (this is cumulative, so the distance is multiplied by 1.8 if both apply). Does not apply when in 2D mode or playing as NiGHTS Super Sonic.

name: cam_height
desc: Sets the height offset of the third-person camera . This is not calculated relative to the bottom of the player, but instead the first-person camera's vertical offset (determined by the player's height).

name: cam_rotate
desc: Sets the angle of the camera's rotation. Minimum value is -720 and maximum value is 720.

name: cam_rotspeed
desc: Sets the rotation speed of the camera in analog control and demo playback. Minimum value is 1, maximum value is 45.

name: cam_speed
desc: Sets the speed of the camera. Minimum value is 0, maximum value is 1. Does not apply when in 2D mode .

name: cam_still
desc: If enabled, the camera angle stays in place instead of rotating with the player.

name: cam_adjust
desc: If enabled, the camera height will automatically be adjusted when going down a slope.

name: defaultcolor
desc: Sets your player's default skin color . Both the colors' names or their number values can be used.

name: color
desc: Sets your player's current skin color . This can only be changed in multiplayer , while the player is standing still. Both the colors' names or their number values can be used. For setting the default color, see defaultcolor/defaultcolor2

name: name
desc: Sets your nickname for multiplayer. It may not start with a number. To use spaces in the name, put it between quotation marks.

name: netstat
desc: If enabled, network statistics for the client are shown on the HUD. These are updated every two seconds.

name: defaultskinskin
desc: Sets your player's character default skin .

name: skin
desc: Sets your player's current character skin . In Single Player the player's character cannot be changed unless development mode is enabled. In multiplayer the player's character can be changed freely barring gametype-specific restrictions (see restrictskinchange ) and provided forceskin is not in effect. Regardless of gametype, character skins can only be changed while the player is standing still. Note that in Single Player, the player's color is changed to the default color for the character, e.

name: advancemap
desc: Sets which map to advance to when a round finishes in any mode except Co-op or Single Player.

name: allowjoin
desc: If enabled, other players may join the netgame.

name: blamecfail
desc: If enabled, the host is notified when a player becomes desynchronized.

name: downloading
desc: Allows/disallows file downloading in a netgame.

name: downloadspeed
desc: Determines the speed of file downloading, in packets per tic. Minimum value is 1, maximum value is 300.

name: inttime
desc: Sets the intermission time between multiplayer levels, in seconds. Minimum value is 0, maximum value is 3600.

name: joinnextround
desc: If enabled, players must wait until the next round is started to join a netgame.

name: jointimeout
desc: Sets how long a joining player may take to download the game state from the server, in tics. One extra tic is added to this time for each kilobyte of the game state. If this time expires, the player will be refused by the server. Minimum value is 5 tics, maximum value is 2100 tics (60 seconds).

name: maxping
desc: If the value is higher than 0, players whose ping is higher than this value will be automatically kicked.

name: maxplayers
desc: Sets the maximum number of players allowed to join a netgame. Minimum value is 2, maximum value is 32.

name: maxsend
desc: Sets the maximum file size (in KB) for files that can be downloaded by joining players. Files beyond this limit cannot be downloaded and players who do not have them will be refused by the server. Players downloading large files from the server will cause noticeable and sometimes disrupting lag in the netgame, so do not set this limit too high. Minimum value is 0 KB, maximum value is 204800 KB (200 MB).

name: mute
desc: If enabled, chatting is disabled for everyone except the host and game admins.

name: nettimeout
desc: Sets the maximum amount of time (in tics) to wait between packets sent before the game considers the player to have timed out from the netgame and kicks them. Minimum value is 5 tics, maximum value is 2100 tics (60 seconds).

name: noticedownload
desc: If enabled, messages are displayed in the console when someone is downloading a file.

name: pausepermission
desc: Determines who can pause a netgame – only the server or all clients.

name: resynchattempts
desc: Sets the number of attempts to resynchronize a desynchronised player before kicking them. Minimum value is 0, maximum value is 20.

name: servername
desc: Sets the default name of a server to be hosted.

name: showjoinaddress
desc: If enabled, the IP addresses of joining players are shown to the host.

name: exitmove
desc: If enabled, players can move after completing the level

name: masterserver
desc: Defines which Master Server SRB2 will connect to.

name: masterserver_update_rate
desc: Sets how often the master server listing of a server is updated, in minutes. Minimum value is 2, maximum value is 60.

name: masterserver_timeout
desc: Sets the maximum time in seconds that contacting the master server is allowed to complete.

name: masterserver_debug
desc: Enables/disables master server debug logging, the output will be saved in latest-log.txt .

name: masterserver_token
desc: Used for optional authentication.with the master server.

name: masterserver_room_id
desc: Specifies the Master Server Room that your server will show up in. The possible values for the official Master Server are:

name: allowexitlevel
desc: If enabled, players can exit the level via Exit Sectors in Match and derived gametypes.

name: allowmlook
desc: If enabled, players can aim up and down with their mouse in a netgame.

name: allowseenames
desc: If enabled, players are allowed to enable seenames in order to see the names of other players when targeting them.

name: allowteamchange
desc: If enabled, players can change teams in Team Match and Capture the Flag . If disabled, players cannot change teams but are allowed to spectate. However, spectators themselves will also not be able to enter the game.

name: autobalance
desc: If set to a value other than 0, teams are automatically balanced in CTF mode. The value (between 1 and 4) defines how great the difference in team members may be before the teams are autobalanced. Setting it to 0 turns autobalancing off.

name: forceskin
desc: Forces all players in the game to automatically switch to the specified character skin , and prevents all players except the server from changing skins while in effect. Only the skin number is accepted, unlike the skin variable – 0 forces Sonic, 1 forces Tails, and 2 forces Knuckles. -1 or any invalid value lifts the forced skin restrictions.

name: friendlyfire
desc: If enabled, players can be hit by rings fired by their teammates.

name: idletime
desc: Set the AFK timeout duration (in minutes) to determine how long a player can remain inactive before being kicked or moved to the spectator team (specified by idleaction console variable).

name: idleaction
desc: Specifies what the game should do with inactive players. The possible values are:

name: overtime
desc: If enabled, a time-limited round of Match or CTF cannot end as long as two or more players/teams lead with the same score – it will continue in overtime until the tie is resolved.

name: pointlimit
desc: Sets a score limit for Match, Tag, Hide & Seek, or CTF games. A value of 0 disables the score limit. The maximum value is 999999990.

name: powerstones
desc: In Match or CTF, determines whether Chaos Emeralds will spawn or not. If this is changed during a game, it will not take effect until the next round/map change.

name: respawndelay
desc: In Match, CTF or Tag, this determines the minimum delay (in seconds) after death before a player can respawn with the jump button. Minimum value is 0, maximum value is 30.

name: respawnitem
desc: Determines whether items will respawn.

name: scrambleonchange
desc: If enabled, teams in a Team Match or CTF game will be scrambled automatically each time the game advances to another map (not if you switch maps manually).

name: skipmapcheck
desc: If enabled, the game will not check to see if a map supports the current gametype before warping to it.

name: specialrings
desc: Sets the availability of special weapon rings . If this is changed during a game, it will not take effect until the next round/map change.

name: suddendeath
desc: If enabled, players will die instantly when hit by a ring (even if super). Note that in Tag and Hide & Seek, there is a bug that causes points to be scored from both tagging and killing a player simultaneously, resulting in scoring 200 points per tag instead of 100. [ confirm? – discuss ]

name: tailspickup
desc: If enabled, flying characters can pick up other characters. If disabled, players become solid and can stand on top of one another to form a ladder.

name: teamscramble
desc: Instantly scrambles the teams in Team Match and CTF. Can also be done using the Scramble Teams option in the pause menu.

name: timelimit
desc: Sets a time limit, in minutes, for Match, Tag, Hide & Seek, or CTF games. A value of 0 disables the time limit. The maximum value is 30 minutes.

name: cooplives
desc: Controls how lives are shared between players in Coop gametypes.

name: countdowntime
desc: Sets the countdown time (in seconds) in a Race game after the leader finishes the race. When the countdown is up, anyone yet to finish dies instantly. Minimum value is 15, maximum value is 9999.

name: hidetime
desc: Sets the number of seconds the non-"it" players in Tag and Hide & Seek have for hiding before the "it" player can move. The value cannot exceed the time limit of the game; if the time limit is disabled, the hiding time cannot be adjusted.

name: matchscoring
desc: Sets the scoring system for Match and CTF games.

name: numlaps
desc: Sets the number of laps on a Circuit mode track. Maximum value is 50.

name: playersforexit
desc: Determines whether a Coop level requires any one player ( One ), 25% ( 1/4 ), 50% ( Half ), 75% ( 3/4 ), or 100% ( All ) of all players to reach the Level End Sign before the level is finished.

name: startinglives
desc: Sets the starting number of lives for players in Coop . A player's lives count is restored to this value when they have lost all lives in the previous stage, or the map command has been used to warp to another stage. Minimum value is 1, maximum value is 99.

name: touchtag
desc: If enabled, the "it" player(s) in Tag and Hide & Seek can tag the fleeing players simply by touching them.

name: usemaplaps
desc: If enabled, the level header parameter NumLaps sets the default number of laps on a Circuit mode track.

name: competitionboxes
desc: Sets the type of monitors used in a Competition game. If you change this setting, it will not take effect until the next round/map change.

name: flagtime
desc: Determines how long a CTF flag will stay in place once thrown or dropped before respawning, in seconds. The maximum value is 300.

name: matchboxes
desc: Sets the type of monitors used in all multiplayer gametypes, except for Coop and Competition – Coop monitors always spawn normally, and Competition monitors are controlled by competitionboxes instead. If you change this setting, it will not take effect until the next round/map change.

name: respawnitemtime
desc: Determines how long, in seconds, it takes for an item to respawn. Minimum value is 1, and maximum value is 300.

name: restrictskinchange
desc: If enabled, the following gametype -specific restrictions are applied for players attempting to change character skins mid-game:

name: tv_1up
desc: Sets the chance of Extra Life Monitors spawning from Random Monitors . Higher values result in a larger chance of the monitor appearing; 0 stops the monitor from appearing entirely. Minimum value is 0, and maximum value is 10.

name: tv_bombshield
desc: Sets the chance of Armageddon Shield Monitors spawning from Random Monitors . Higher values result in a larger chance of the monitor appearing; 0 stops the monitor from appearing entirely. Minimum value is 0, and maximum value is 10.

name: tv_eggman
desc: Sets the chance of Eggman Monitors spawning from Random Monitors . Higher values result in a larger chance of the monitor appearing; 0 stops the monitor from appearing entirely. Minimum value is 0, and maximum value is 10.

name: tv_forceshield
desc: Sets the chance of Force Shield Monitors spawning from Random Monitors . Higher values result in a larger chance of the monitor appearing; 0 stops the monitor from appearing entirely. Minimum value is 0, and maximum value is 10.

name: tv_invincibility
desc: Sets the chance of Invincibility Monitors spawning from Random Monitors . Higher values result in a larger chance of the monitor appearing; 0 stops the monitor from appearing entirely. Minimum value is 0, and maximum value is 10.

name: tv_jumpshield
desc: Sets the chance of Whirlwind Shield Monitors spawning from Random Monitors . Higher values result in a larger chance of the monitor appearing; 0 stops the monitor from appearing entirely. Minimum value is 0, and maximum value is 10.

name: tv_recycler
desc: Sets the chance of Recycler Monitors spawning from Random Monitors . Higher values result in a larger chance of the monitor appearing; 0 stops the monitor from appearing entirely. Minimum value is 0, and maximum value is 10.

name: tv_ringshield
desc: Sets the chance of Attraction Shield Monitors spawning from Random Monitors . Higher values result in a larger chance of the monitor appearing; 0 stops the monitor from appearing entirely. Minimum value is 0, and maximum value is 10.

name: tv_superring
desc: Sets the chance of Super Ring Monitors spawning from Random Monitors . Higher values result in a larger chance of the monitor appearing; 0 stops the monitor from appearing entirely. Minimum value is 0, and maximum value is 10.

name: tv_supersneaker
desc: Sets the chance of Super Sneakers Monitors spawning from Random Monitors . Higher values result in a larger chance of the monitor appearing; 0 stops the monitor from appearing entirely. Minimum value is 0, and maximum value is 10.

name: tv_teleporter
desc: Sets the chance of Teleporter Monitors spawning from Random Monitors . Higher values result in a larger chance of the monitor appearing; 0 stops the monitor from appearing entirely. Minimum value is 0, and maximum value is 10.

name: tv_watershield
desc: Sets the chance of Elemental Shield Monitors spawning from Random Monitors . Higher values result in a larger chance of the monitor appearing; 0 stops the monitor from appearing entirely. Minimum value is 0, and maximum value is 10.

name: gravity
desc: Sets the global gravity .

name: killingdead
desc: If enabled, hitting an enemy or popping a monitor causes damage to yourself 75% of the time. This simulates a glitch from the original Sonic Robo Blast .

name: ringslinger
desc: If enabled, players can throw rings outside of the Match , Tag or CTF gametypes.

name: cd_update
desc: This variable currently has no effect. It was intended for the DOS port, which is no longer supported.

name: cd_volume
desc: Determines the volume of the background music played from a music CD. Maximum value is 31. Note: This variable has no effect as of v2.1.25.

name: closedcaptioning
desc: Toggles closed captioning for currently playing sound effects.

name: digimusic
desc: Toggles digital background music.

name: digmusicvolume
desc: Determines the volume of the digital background music. Maximum value is 31.

name: midimusic
desc: Toggles MIDI background music.

name: midimusicvolume
desc: Determines the volume of the MIDI background music. Maximum value is 31.

name: precachesound
desc: If enabled, the game precaches sound effects into memory before starting the game.

name: resetmusic
desc: If enabled, the music will start over in Single Player after you die, like in most Sonic games.

name: samplerate
desc: Supposedly changes the sample rate of sounds played by SRB2, but currently does nothing. [ confirm? – discuss ]

name: snd_channels
desc: Sets the number of sound channels.

name: sounds
desc: Toggles sound.

name: soundtest
desc: Plays the sound corresponding to the specified sound number. Refer to the list of sounds for a complete list of sounds and their numbers.

name: soundvolume
desc: Determines the volume of sound effects. Maximum value is 31.

name: stereoreverse
desc: If enabled, the stereo channels are reversed.

name: surround
desc: Toggles surround sound.

name: drawdist
desc: Sets the maximum distance (in fracunits) from the player at which sprites are drawn – sprites beyond the specified distance (unless set to " Infinite ") will be completely invisible to the player. Only certain distances are accepted by this variable, listed below:

name: drawdist_nights
desc: Sets the maximum distance (in fracunits) from the player at which sprites are drawn in NiGHTS levels – sprites beyond the specified distance (unless set to " Infinite ") will be completely invisible to the player. Only certain distances are accepted by this variable, listed below:

name: drawdist_precip
desc: Sets the maximum distance (in fracunits) from the player at which precipitation (i.e. rain, snow) is drawn – precipitation beyond the specified distance (unless set to " Infinite ") will be completely invisible to the player. Only certain distances are accepted by this variable, listed below:

name: fov
desc: Sets the field of view. It affects the focal length (in degrees) of the camera . For example, smaller values make the camera focus on a smaller portion of the world, similarly to a telescopic sight or scope. Minimum value is 60, maximum value is 179.

name: fullscreen
desc: Determines whether the game is displayed in fullscreen or windowed mode.

name: gamma
desc: Sets the game's overall brightness. Maximum value is 5, minimum value is -15.

name: homremoval
desc: If set to yes , all occurrences of the hall of mirrors glitch on the screen will be replaced with a solid black color. If set to flash , these areas will additionally flash red continuously.

name: maxportals
desc: Sets the maximum recursive depth of visual portal rendering. 0 disables visual portals, the maximum value is 12. Disclaimer: Setting this value too high can cause severe lag or memory overflow crashes in complicated visual portal setups!

name: renderview
desc: If disabled, the view of the level will no longer be rendered.

name: scr_depth
desc: Sets the default graphical depth of the screen resolution.

name: scr_height
desc: Sets the default screen resolution height. Make sure to use only video modes supported by your computer or SRB2.

name: scr_width
desc: Sets the default screen resolution width. Make sure to use only video modes supported by your computer or SRB2.

name: showfps
desc: If enabled, a framerate counter is displayed on the HUD .

name: skybox
desc: Toggles whether or not skyboxes are rendered.

name: stretch
desc: Does nothing. Was supposed to determine whether to allow screen resolution width-height ratios other than the standard (320:200, or 1.6:1). If disabled, the resolution height would be adjusted according to its width to keep the standard ratio; if enabled, the height would remain unchanged.

name: translucency
desc: Turns sprite translucency on or off.

name: vid_wait
desc: Enables/disables vertical synchronization .

name: fpscap
desc: Limits the maximum number of frames-per-second that can be rendered. Minimum value is TICRATE , maximum value is 300. Certain values are also accepted by this variable, listed below:

name: gr_models
desc: Determines whether models are rendered.

name: gr_modelinterpolation
desc: Determines model interpolation behavior. If set to Sometimes , only specified animations will interpolate their frames.

name: gr_spritebillboarding
desc: Determines whether sprites will have the billboarding effect applied to them or not. This means that, if enabled, they will appear to rotate to face the camera vertically if they are viewed from above or below; otherwise, they will appear as flat polygons when seen from above or below.

name: gr_skydome
desc: Determines whether or not to render the sky texture as a dome.

name: gr_filtermode
desc: Sets the texture filtering mode.

name: gr_anisotropicmode
desc: Sets the degree of anisotropic filtering . Minimum value is 1, maximum is defined by the GPU ( GL_MAX_TEXTURE_MAX_ANISOTROPY_EXT ). Note that this variable can only be modified in-game if SRB2 was ever running in OpenGL.

name: gr_fovchange
desc: If enabled, the field of view widens as the player's speed increases to simulate the character getting further away from the camera.

name: gr_solvetjoin
desc: Determines whether or not to solve T-joins.

name: gr_allowclientshaders
desc: Sets whenever or not custom OpenGL Shaders are allowed to used in the server.

name: gr_shaders
desc: Determines whether or not shaders are enabled. If set to Ignore custom shaders , only built-in shaders will be used.

name: cpusleep
desc: Calms down a number of common processes to reserve CPU power for SRB2, by telling the processes to sleep for a set period of time. Highly recommended for older computers or computers struggling with their OS. Values range from -1 to 28, -1 being off and 0 to 28 being the time to sleep, measured in milliseconds.

Creates an alias for another console command or a sequence of commands. For instance, alias sonic "skin sonic; color blue" would create a new console command sonic that turns the player into a blue Sonic. This command is especially useful in scripts to create a shorthand for a sequence of commands that is used multiple times. Note that alias commands are not saved when the game is closed. To create a permanent alias, put it in the autoexec.cfg file.

name: cls
desc: Clears the console buffer.

name: help
desc: If used without an argument, displays a list of console commands and variables (some variables will not be displayed, such as a few cheats). If provided with the name of a command/variable, detailed info for that command/variable will be provided, if available. For variables, it also displays a list of possible values, the current value and the variable's flags.

name: toggle
desc: Toggles the value of the given console variable. This only works with variables that take boolean values (i.e. yes/no or on/off).

name: wait
desc: Waits for the specified number of game tics before executing the next console command. One second consists of 35 tics. If no number is specified, a one tic delay is used by default. There is generally no reason to use this directly, but it is useful to create delays in scripts .

name: addfile
desc: Adds a WAD , PK3 , SOC , or Lua script to the game. The file extension must be specified, e.g., addfile test.wad instead of addfile test . After adding a file, the game will immediately be marked as modified, unless it is a WAD that contains only music and sound effects.

name: changeconfig
desc: Saves the current configuration file and loads the specified one. The file name is required to end with .cfg – if the file extension is not specified or is not the correct one, the game will automatically modify the file name given to end with .cfg anyway.

name: loadconfig
desc: Loads the specified configuration file without saving the current one. The file name is required to end with .cfg – if the file extension is not specified or is not the correct one, the game will automatically modify the file name given to end with .cfg anyway.

name: runsoc
desc: Loads the specified SOC . This can be either a stand-alone file (requires the file name to end with .soc , which must be specified) or a lump in one of the currently loaded WAD or PK3 files.

name: displayplayer
desc: Shows the number of the player who is currently being displayed.

name: exitgame
desc: Exits the current game and returns to the title screen.

name: gametype
desc: Shows the current gametype as one of the following numbers:

name: map
desc: Changes the level. For instance, to warp to Greenflower Zone Act 1 , type map 1 . You can also type the zone's abbrevation, such as map gfz1 . For the map numbers of official SRB2 maps, consult the list of levels . If you want to know the map number of a custom map, open the file containing the map in a lump editor and look for the SOC lump containing the level header (which is often the MAINCFG lump). In that lump, search for the map name and look at its corresponding map number. The map comman

name: manual
desc: Opens the game's manual.

name: pause
desc: Pauses the game. Reuse it to unpause. If a number is given, the game will pause if 1 is supplied or unpause if 0 is supplied, but not vice versa.

name: playintro
desc: Replays the opening intro.

name: quit
desc: Exits the game immediately, skipping all menus and displays.

name: resetcamera
desc: Resets the camera 's position and properties. The player's "reset camera" key has the same function as this.

name: retry
desc: Retries the current level from the last Star Post . The player needs to have at least one life left to do this, and one life will be subtracted from their count.

name: showmap
desc: Shows the map number and the name (excluding "Zone" and "Act") of the map currently being played.

name: devmode
desc: Activates development mode and sets its flags. See development mode for deeper info.

name: exitlevel
desc: Finishes the current level and warps to the next one (after the score tally/intermission screen).

name: getallemeralds
desc: Gives the player all 7 Chaos Emeralds .

name: god
desc: Makes the player invincible to everything, including instant kill hazards. Use the command again to make the player vulnerable again.

name: gravflip
desc: Flips the direction of gravity .

name: hurtme
desc: Hurts the player. The only value with special significance is 10000, which will instantly kill the player.

name: jumptoaxis
desc: In NiGHTS , this teleports the player to the specified Axis .

name: noclip
desc: Turns off the player's collision, allowing them to walk through walls. Deaths by crushing are also prevented, but all other types of damage are still in effect. Use the command again to re-enable collision.

name: notarget
desc: Prevents any enemies that have not already targeted the player from doing so, allowing the player to freely move around the enemies without being attacked by them. Use the command again to re-enable targeting.

name: objectplace
desc: Activates Object placement mode . Use the command again to deactivate it. The parameter -silent suppresses the on-screen text explaining the controls.

name: resetemeralds
desc: Removes all Chaos Emeralds from the player's possession.

name: savecheckpoint
desc: Creates a temporary and invisible Star Post at the player's current location. The Star Post disappears once the player exits the map or activates another Star Post.

name: scale
desc: Scales the player to a fraction of their original size – 1 is normal size, 0.5 is half the normal size, 2 is twice the normal size, and so forth.

name: setcontinues
desc: Sets the number of continues the player has.

name: setlives
desc: Sets the number of lives the player has.

name: setrings
desc: Sets the number of rings the player is carrying.

name: skynum
desc: Changes the sky. Refer to Flats and textures/Skies for a list of skies with samples and slot numbers.

name: weather
desc: Changes the weather. Refer to Level header > Weather for a list of weather types with slot numbers.

name: toggletwod
desc: Toggles between 2D mode and 3D mode. Note that this won't have any effect if the level header is set to use 2D mode.

name: clearbans
desc: Clears all bans. Users that were banned will be able to join again.

name: clearscores
desc: Resets all players' scores to 0. This also works in Single Player games.

name: csay
desc: Sends a message to everyone within a netgame which is displayed in the center of the screen. Backslashes indicate line breaks.

name: demote
desc: Removes administrative privileges from a player in a netgame.

name: motd
desc: Sets a "Message of the day" that is displayed in a player's chat log when they join your server. Note that semicolons ( ; ) are not allowed in the message, and will be removed if found. Due to a glitch, sometimes trying to change the message after it was already set will instead cause the new message to be appended to the end of the previous one.

name: password
desc: Changes the server password to the given value.

name: promote
desc: Gives a player administrative privileges in a netgame.

name: reloadbans
desc: Reloads an existing ban.txt and bans all of the included IP addresses.

name: showbanlist
desc: Lists all bans made in-game and in ban.txt along with the ban reasons.

name: masterserver_update
desc: Force the Master Server listing of a server to be updated.

name: changeteam
desc: Changes the team you are currently playing for. You can also use this command to become a spectator, clearing your score and turning you into an invisible bystander, or to enter the game after spectating. Does not work in Co-op, Race or Competition.

name: connect
desc: Used to connect to a server, depending on the parameters used:

name: listserv
desc: Retrieves and displays a list of hosted games from the Master Server .

name: login
desc: Attempts to log in as a netgame administrator. The password is set by the host.

name: cheats
desc: When used without a parameter, states whether any cheat-marked variables have been modified. Entering cheats off will revert all cheat-marked variables to their default values.

name: getplayernum
desc: Lists all of the players in the game, their player numbers, and their node numbers.

name: nodes
desc: Lists all of the players in the game and their node numbers.

name: ping
desc: Lists the ping for all other players, i.e., the time it takes to send a packet from the server to the player and back.

name: say
desc: Sends a chat message to all players.

name: sayteam
desc: Sends a chat message to your team. Only meant to be used in team-based gametypes like Team Match, Tag, Hide & Seek, or CTF. The host of a dedicated server cannot use this, since they are not playing themselves and therefore do not belong to any team.

name: showscores
desc: Shows the game scores of all players. Also displays the point limit of the game.

name: showtime
desc: Shows the time and, if applicable, the time limit of the current game.

name: suicide
desc: Kills the player and subtracts one life. Useful if you've become stuck in an area you can't escape from.

name: vid_info
desc: Displays information about the current engine mode and video mode.

name: vid_mode
desc: Sets the video mode. To see which video mode corresponds to which number, use vid_modelist .

name: vid_modelist
desc: Lists all available video modes along with their screen resolutions and their corresponding mode numbers.

name: vid_nummodes
desc: Shows the number of available video modes.

name: countmobjs
desc: Counts all Objects of the specified Object type in the level and displays the total in the console. The Object type must be specified as a number; consult List of Object types for the numbers corresponding to the Object types. If no Object type is specified, the total number of Objects is listed for each Object type present in the map. Precipitation Objects such as rain or snow will not be counted.

name: gr_stats
desc: Displays OpenGL-specific memory usage statistics.

name: isgamemodified
desc: Checks if the game is modified and if secrets can be unlocked, and displays the result in the console.

name: listwad
desc: Displays a list of WAD and PK3 files loaded in the game, in inverse order to the order in which they were loaded. The total number of files loaded is displayed at the top of the list. Files listed with file numbers colored yellow are the resource files for SRB2. "IWAD" is displayed next to the IWAD ( srb2.pk3 ). All other resource files are listed with an asterisk ( * ) preceding the file number.

name: mapmd5
desc: Displays the MD5 checksum of the current map.

name: memfree
desc: Displays memory usage statistics.

name: mod_details
desc: Lists the ID, version and codebase of the executable currently used. In SRB2 v2.2.13, this will print "Mod ID: 18", "Mod Version: 54", and "Code Base: 220".

name: numthinkers
desc: Counts the number of thinkers of a particular type, listed below. Useful for development and code testing.

name: version
desc: Displays the version of SRB2 being used, along with the date, time and revision number at which the executable was compiled, along with the interface, operating system and the processor architecture. For example, on the 32-bit version of SRB2 v2.2.0 for Windows, this will print:

name: cecho
desc: Displays the specified message in the center of the screen. Backslashes indicate line breaks.

name: cechoduration
desc: Changes the duration that a cecho message stays on screen, in seconds.

name: cechoflags
desc: Sets the flags for cecho . Hexadecimal numbers are also accepted as values, provided the input is prefixed with 0x . See Video flags for the full list of flags and their values.

name: echo
desc: Displays the specified message in the console. Useful for scripting.

name: playdemo
desc: Plays back a recorded demo .

name: screenshot
desc: Takes a screenshot of the display. Note that if you type this command directly into the console, the console will appear in the screenshot. To avoid this, use the shortcut F8 or bind the command to a key.

name: startmovie
desc: Creates a movie of the game, which will output as a GIF, animated PNG or multiple screenshots depending on the mode set by moviemode_mode .

name: stopdemo
desc: Stops the currently running demo .

name: stopmovie
desc: Stops recording the movie started with startmovie .

name: restartaudio
desc: Restarts the game's audio playback system. If you changed your audio output device mid-game, use this command to make the game switch to the new device.

name: http_source
desc: URL of a website with the server's addons. Joining players download missing addons from <url>/<file name> over HTTP instead of from the server.
